text:
Type: long white chest of drawers
Use: storing clothes, linens and media, long top for a TV or decor; bedroom, living room
Style: minimalist, Scandinavian, modern
Materials: white matte painted fiberboard, black slot grips
Colors: white, black grip accents
Shape: long low chest with nine drawers in three columns, broader middle column, flush handleless fronts with black cut-out grips at the top edge, flat top, low plinth, clean geometric lines, broad visual weight
Feel: clean, orderly, bright, calm
Goes with: light wood floors, white or grey walls, black accents; minimalist, Scandinavian or modern rooms

product.name: NORDLI
product.description: Of course your home should be a safe place for the entire family. Thats why a safety fitting is included so that you can attach the chest of drawers to the wall.
